records.issue_text: No check on booking status; guests can be added to cancelled/rejected bookings, generating confirmed emails/ICS for events that don't exist
records.rationale: The new `addGuestsHandler` updates attendees and sends calendar update emails without checking any booking state/status. In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the booking is fetched and then always updated via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`, and then `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` and `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`

records.issue_text: prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } }) throws an unhandled NotFoundError (500) for bookings with no userId instead of a proper TRPCError
records.rationale: In the new addGuests handler, `prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } })` will call `findFirstOrThrow` with `id: 0` when `booking.userId` is falsy. If a booking can exist without a `userId`, this will throw Prisma's NotFound error and is not converted to a `TRPCError`, resulting in an unhandled 500 from this mutation.

records.issue_text: isInvalidEmail in AddGuestsDialog is never cleared when the user edits emails or retries, so the error banner persists after input becomes valid; only Cancel resets it
records.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `safeParse` fails in `handleAdd`, but it is not reset when the user edits the emails via `MultiEmail` (`setMultiEmailValue` is called without clearing the flag) and it is also not reset on a successful add (`onSuccess` closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue` but does not call `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`).
